headline: Public hearings on subdivisions and site plans for Wellington Road, Lowell Street, Cohas Avenue, and other properties.
summary: The biggest item is a 16-story building with 196 homes and a 330-space garage on the city's Lowell Street parking lot. A request would move the 34-lot Wellington Road subdivision to December 3, 2026.
items: S2026-005: Continued from October 1, 2026. Subdivision for 34 new buildable lots with public roads and a wetland crossing at Wellington Road (Tax Map 860, Lot 30). Request to continue to December 3, 2026.

SP2026-019: Continued from October 1, 2026. Site plan to redevelop the municipal parking lot at 99 Lowell Street (Tax Map 10, Lot 6) into a 16-story mixed-use building with 196 residential units, up to 7,325 sf of commercial space, and a 330-space parking garage.
S2026-018: Continued from October 1, 2026. Lot line adjustment at 333 Cohas Avenue (Tax Map 612, Lots 2 and 3) to move Parcel A of 9,393 s.f. from Lot 2 to Lot 3.
S2026-007: Subdivision at 1308 Wellington Road (Tax Map 860, Lots 1 and 2A) for 16 new buildable lots with public roads, a wetland crossing, and water service by easement.
S2026-017: Subdivision at 659 Montgomery Street (Tax Map 307, Lot 3) to create one 5,005 square foot lot, leaving the existing two-family dwelling on its own 5,005 square foot lot.
CU2026-012 (re-numbered from CU2026-013): Conditional use permit at 223 Second Street (Tax Map 200, Lot 18) to reduce parking from 110 required spaces to 25 proposed.
SP2026-020: Site plan to add one dwelling unit to an existing three-unit building at 502 Cartier Street (Tax Map 178, Lot 46).
location: City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers, One City Hall Plaza, Manchester, New Hampshire 03101

 MANCHESTER PLANNING BOARD 
PUBLIC HEARING MEETING AGENDA 
Thursday, November 5, 2026 – 6:00 PM 
City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers 
Revised November 4, 2026 
 
I. The Chair calls the meeting to order and introduces Planning Board members and Planning 
staff. 
 
II. PUBLIC HEARING: 
 
1. S2026-005 – Continued from October 1, 2026 
Property located at Wellington Road (Tax Map 860, Lot 30), a subdivision application for the 
creation of 34 new buildable lots with new public roads and a wetland crossing, in the Lake 
Massabesic Protection Overlay and R -1A Zoning District. Granite Engineering, LLC for 
Manchester Water Works. (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance). 
Request for continuance to December 3, 2026. 
 
2. SP2026-019 – Continued from October 1, 2026 
Property located at 99 Lowell Street (Tax Map 10, Lot 6) , a site plan application for the 
redevelopment of the existing municipal parking lot to a mixed use 16- story building with 196 
residential units and up to 7,325 sf of commercial space on the first level, and a 330 space, 3- story 
parking garage, located in the DT-2 Zoning District.  Fuss and O’Neil for the City of Manchester. 
(Reviewed under current zoning ordinance). 
 
 (New Items) 
With respect to the following applications, appropriate materials have been submitted to invoke the 
jurisdiction of the Board. Although additional information may be required prior to final 
consideration, it is the recommendation of Staff that the Planning Board determine the applications 
complete and conduct a public hearing. A motion would be in order. 
  
3. S2026-018 – Continued from October 1, 2026 
Property located at 333 Cohas Avenue (Tax Map 612, Lots 2 and 3) , a subdivision/lot line 
adjustment application to annex Parcel A of 9,393 s.f. from Tax Map 612, Lot 2 to Tax Map 612, 
Lot 3, located in an R-1A Zoning District.  Lavelle Associates for Echelon Development, LLC.      
(Reviewed under current zoning ordinance). 
                                                                                        
 
4. S2026-007 
Property located at 1308 Wellington Road (Tax Map 860, Lots 1 and 2A), a subdivision 
application for the creation of 16 new buildable lots with new public roads, a wetland crossing, and 
water service proposed by easement, in the Lake Massabesic Protection Overlay and R-1A Zoning

District. Arago Land Consultants, LLC for Manchester Christian Church.  (Reviewed under prior 
zoning ordinance).  
 
5. S2026-017 
Property located at 659 Montgomery Street (Tax Map 307, Lot 3), a subdivision application for 
the creation of one new buildable lot of 5,005 square feet, leaving the existing two-family dwelling 
on its own 5,005 square foot lot, in the MX-2 Zoning District.  Joseph M. Wichert, LLC, Inc. for 
Joseph Pantaleo. (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance). 
 
6. CU2026-012 (re-numbered from CU2026-013) 
Property located at 223 Second Street (Tax Map 200, Lot 18) , a conditional use permit 
application for a parking reduction where 110 parking spaces are required and 25 are proposed, in 
the BC-1 Zoning District. Thomas DeBlois.  (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance). 
 
7. SP2026-020 
Property located at 502 Cartier Street (Tax Map 178, Lot 46) , a site plan review application to 
add one dwelling unit to an existing three dwelling unit building in the MX -2 Zoning District. , 
Joseph M. Wichert, LLC, Inc . for Providenciales, LLC c/o Corneliu Stanciu.  (Reviewed under 
current zoning ordinance). 
 
III. ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS: 
 
1. Review and approval of the Planning Board minutes of October 1, 2026. 
 
2. Distribution of the Planning Board minutes of October 15, 2026, for review and approval at the 
meeting of November 19, 2026. 
 
3. Any other business items from the Planning Staff or Board Members. 
 
 
Full text of the agenda items is on file for review in the Planning & Community Development Department.
